Choose Your Solutions

These are the possible investments your community can make to improve its resilience and rebuild trust. Select the best options to mitigate the impact of the disaster.

Design Solutions

Seismic Retrofitting

Cost: 20M

Strengthens existing buildings and infrastructure to withstand seismic activity, reducing structural damage and saving lives.

Levee & Floodwall Upgrades

Cost: 15M

Reinforces riverbanks and coastal defenses to protect against storm surges and large-scale flooding events.

Defensible Space Program

Cost: 5M

Clears vegetation around homes and uses fire-resistant materials to create a buffer zone against wildfires.

Utility Grid Hardening

Cost: 10M

Buries power lines and reinforces critical infrastructure to withstand extreme weather and maintain power during a disaster.

Smart Building Codes

Cost: 3M

Updates local construction codes to require modern materials and design principles that enhance resilience to specific natural disasters.

Response Solutions

Public Safety Campaign

Cost: 2M

Educates citizens on preparedness, evacuation routes, and what to do during and after a disaster.

Modern Early Warning System

Cost: 8M

Installs sensors and sirens to provide real-time alerts about impending floods, fires, or seismic events.

Emergency Supply Stockpile

Cost: 4M

Builds and maintains a secure cache of food, water, medical supplies, and generators for post-disaster use.

Post-Disaster Relief Funds

Cost: 1M

Establishes a fund to provide immediate financial aid to residents and small businesses affected by a disaster.
